pluginConfigFields.label: Tektronix API path (Windows)
pluginConfigFields.help: Optional absolute path to RSA_API.dll, or its directory. Leave empty to use standard Tektronix installation locations.

pluginConfigFields.label: Native worker path (advanced, macOS)
pluginConfigFields.help: Optional absolute path to a compatible arm64 rsa306 worker. Leave empty to use the bundled worker.

pluginConfigFields.label: Python interpreter (advanced, Windows)
pluginConfigFields.help: Optional absolute path to Python. Leave empty to use the bundled isolated runtime.

deviceConfigFields.label: Analyzer serial number
deviceConfigFields.help: Select the attached analyzer by serial number. Discovery fills this automatically.
